<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/delivery.ts -->
<!--
  Delivery zones and their prices as a table or as cards: the zone and its areas, the price, the order that
  ships free, the minimum order, the time and an express badge. Axes: layout (table, cards), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Zone, ZoneLabels } from "./zone-table.types";

  export type ZoneTableProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    zones: Zone[];
    labels: ZoneLabels;
    layout?: "table" | "cards";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import ZoneRows from "../components/zone-rows.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    zones,
    labels,
    layout = "table",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: ZoneTableProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} density={density}>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "table")}
    <ZoneRows zones={zones} labels={labels} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each zones as z (z.id)}
        <Stack gap="4" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-testid="item">
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
              {z.name}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {z.area}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Text size="3xl" weight="bold">
            {fmtMoney(z.price, z.currency)}
          </Text>
          <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
            <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {labels.freeFrom}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {fmtMoney(z.freeFrom, z.currency)}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {labels.minOrder}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {fmtMoney(z.minOrder, z.currency)}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {labels.time}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {z.time}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
          {#if z.express}
            <Badge variant="secondary" size="default" class="w-fit">
              {z.express}
            </Badge>
          {/if}
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
